CREATE TABLE "public"."account" (
  "accessToken" text,
  "accessTokenExpiresAt" timestamptz,
  "accountId" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "idToken" text,
  "password" text,
  "providerId" text NOT NULL,
  "refreshToken" text,
  "refreshTokenExpiresAt" timestamptz,
  "scope" text,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."activity" (
  "action" text NOT NULL,
  "actorId" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "details" jsonb,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "projectId" uuid,
  "taskId" uuid,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."calendar_event" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "createdById" text NOT NULL,
  "description" text,
  "endsAt" timestamptz,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "location" text,
  "projectId" uuid,
  "startsAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "title" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."calendar_event_attendee" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "eventId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("eventId", "userId")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."comment" (
  "authorId" text NOT NULL,
  "body" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "deletedAt" timestamptz,
  "deletedById" text,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "taskId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."comment_reaction" (
  "commentId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "emoji" text NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("commentId", "userId", "emoji")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."company_settings" (
  "id" text DEFAULT 'company' NOT NULL,
  "name" text DEFAULT 'Gr8r Studio' NOT NULL,
  "settings" jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb NOT NULL,
  "timeZone" text DEFAULT 'UTC' NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."favorite_project" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "projectId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("userId", "projectId")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."favorite_task" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "taskId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("userId", "taskId")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."file_asset" (
  "contentType" text,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "deletedAt" timestamptz,
  "deletedById" text,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "originalName" text NOT NULL,
  "projectId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "sizeBytes" int8 NOT NULL,
  "storageKey" text NOT NULL,
  "taskId" uuid,
  "uploadedById" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."label" (
  "color" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."notification" (
  "actorId" text,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "projectId" uuid,
  "readAt" timestamptz,
  "snippet" text,
  "taskId" uuid,
  "text" text NOT NULL,
  "type" text NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "notification_type_check_9769ec0e" CHECK ("type" IN ('mention', 'assignment', 'comment', 'update'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."notification_preference" (
  "channel" text NOT NULL,
  "enabled" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "eventType" text NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."project" (
  "archivedAt" timestamptz,
  "archivedById" text,
  "color" text DEFAULT 'slate' NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "description" text,
  "dueDate" date,
  "icon" text DEFAULT 'folder' NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "key" text NOT NULL,
  "leadId" text,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "position" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "startDate" date,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'planning' NOT NULL,
  "teamId" uuid,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "project_status_check_6a38622b" CHECK ("status" IN ('planning', 'active', 'risk', 'hold', 'complete'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."project_member" (
  "joinedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "projectId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("projectId", "userId")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."project_milestone" (
  "completedAt" timestamptz,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "dueDate" date,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "position" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "projectId" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."recent_search" (
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "query" text NOT NULL,
  "searchedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."saved_view" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "filters" jsonb DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb NOT NULL,
  "groupBy" text,
  "hiddenColumns" jsonb DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "isShared" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "projectId" uuid,
  "sort" jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb NOT NULL,
  "type" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "saved_view_type_check_422226e3" CHECK ("type" IN ('board', 'list', 'table', 'calendar', 'timeline'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."session" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "expiresAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "impersonatedBy" text,
  "ipAddress" text,
  "token" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "userAgent" text,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."task" (
  "archivedAt" timestamptz,
  "archivedById" text,
  "completedAt" timestamptz,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "createdById" text NOT NULL,
  "description" text,
  "dueDate" date,
  "estimate" text,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "position" float8 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "priority" text DEFAULT 'none' NOT NULL,
  "projectId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "projectTaskNumber" int4 NOT NULL,
  "startDate" date,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'todo' NOT NULL,
  "title" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "task_priority_check_50cc6a72" CHECK ("priority" IN ('urgent', 'high', 'medium', 'low', 'none')),
  CONSTRAINT "task_status_check_3309391b" CHECK ("status" IN ('backlog', 'todo', 'progress', 'review', 'done'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."task_assignee" (
  "assignedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "assignedById" text NOT NULL,
  "taskId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("taskId", "userId")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."task_dependency" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "dependsOnTaskId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "taskId" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("taskId", "dependsOnTaskId")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."task_label" (
  "labelId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "taskId" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("taskId", "labelId")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."task_recurrence" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "endsOn" date,
  "frequency" text NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "interval" int4 DEFAULT 1 NOT NULL,
  "nextRunAt" date,
  "taskId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "weekDays" jsonb,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "task_recurrence_frequency_check_e44b28ab" CHECK ("frequency" IN ('daily', 'weekly', 'biweekly', 'monthly'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."task_subtask" (
  "completedAt" timestamptz,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "isCompleted" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "position" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "taskId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "title" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."team" (
  "color" text DEFAULT '#8A867E' NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "description" text,
  "icon" text DEFAULT 'users' NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."user" (
  "banExpires" timestamptz,
  "banReason" text,
  "banned" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "email" text NOT NULL,
  "emailVerified" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "employeeNumber" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "image" text,
  "jobTitle" text,
  "mustChangePassword" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "role" text DEFAULT 'employee' NOT NULL,
  "teamId" uuid,
  "timeZone" text,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "user_role_valid_2461e6a1" CHECK (role IN ('admin', 'employee'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."user_preference" (
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "key" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  "value" jsonb NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."verification" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()),
  "expiresAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "identifier" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()),
  "value" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)
